```json
  "title": "FindFolderResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "incompleteSearch",
        "files",
        "display_url",
        "link_label"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "kind": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Kind",
          "default": "drive#fileList",
          "description": "Identifies this as a files list resource; always 'drive#fileList'."
        },
        "files": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "GoogleDriveFolderItem",
            "required": [
              "id",
              "name",
              "mimeType"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "id": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Id",
                "description": "The ID of the file."
              },
              "kind": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Kind",
                "default": "drive#file",
                "description": "Identifies this as a file resource; always \"drive#file\"."
              },
              "name": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Name",
                "description": "The name of the file (not necessarily unique within a folder)."
              },
              "size": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Size",
                "description": "The size of the file's content in bytes (as a string). Only applicable to files with binary content; not present for Google Docs editors files."
              },
              "owners": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "title": "GoogleDriveUser",
                  "properties": {
                    "me": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "title": "Me",
                      "description": "Whether this user is the authenticated user."
                    },
                    "kind": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Kind",
                      "default": "drive#user",
                      "description": "Identifies this as a user; always 'drive#user'."
                    },
                    "photoLink": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Photo Link",
                      "format": "uri",
                      "maxLength": 2083,
                      "minLength": 1,
                      "description": "A link to the user's profile photo."
                    },
                    "displayName": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Display Name",
                      "description": "The user's display name."
                    },
                    "emailAddress": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Email Address",
                      "description": "The user's email address. Present only if the user has chosen to reveal it or the requesting app has appropriate permissions."
                    },
                    "permissionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Permission Id",
                      "description": "The user's permission ID (deprecated, may be absent)."
                    }
                  }
                },
                "title": "Owners",
                "description": "The owners of the file. Not populated for items in shared drives unless the requesting user is an organizer."
              },
              "shared": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Shared",
                "description": "Whether the file has been shared."
              },
              "spaces": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "title": "Spaces",
                "description": "The list of spaces the file is in. Supported values include 'drive', 'appDataFolder', and 'photos'."
              },
              "driveId": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Drive Id",
                "description": "ID of the shared drive the file resides in. Only present for items in shared drives."
              },
              "parents": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "title": "Parents",
                "description": "The IDs of the parent folders. If not specified, the file resides in the root folder."
              },
              "starred": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Starred",
                "description": "Whether the user has starred the file."
              },
              "trashed": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Trashed",
                "description": "Whether the file has been trashed."
              },
              "version": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Version",
                "description": "A monotonically increasing version number for the file (as a string)."
              },
              "iconLink": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Icon Link",
                "format": "uri",
                "maxLength": 2083,
                "minLength": 1,
                "description": "A static, opaque link to the file's icon."
              },
              "mimeType": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Mime Type",
                "description": "The MIME type of the file. For folders, this is 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder'."
              },
              "ownedByMe": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Owned By Me",
                "description": "Whether the file is owned by the authenticated user."
              },
              "link_label": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Link Label",
                "description": "Human-readable label for the display_url link."
              },
              "properties": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "Properties",
                "description": "A collection of arbitrary key-value pairs set by the user.",
                "additionalProperties": true
              },
              "viewedByMe": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "title": "Viewed By Me",
                "description": "Whether the file has been viewed by this user."
              },
              "createdTime": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Created Time",
                "format": "date-time",
                "description": "The time at which the file was created (RFC 3339 date-time)."
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Description",
                "description": "A short description of the file."
              },
              "display_url": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Display Url",
                "description": "A link to view this folder in Google Drive."
              },
              "exportLinks": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "Export Links",
                "description": "Links for exporting Google Workspace document types to various MIME types. Keys are MIME types, values are export URLs.",
                "additionalProperties": true
              },
              "md5Checksum": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Md5 Checksum",
                "description": "The MD5 checksum for the content of the file. Only available for files with binary content. For multipart uploads, only available when uploaded in a single part."
              },
              "permissions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "title": "GoogleDrivePermission",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Id",
                      "description": "The ID of the permission."
                    },
                    "kind": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Kind",
                      "default": "drive#permission",
                      "description": "Identifies this as a permission; always 'drive#permission'."
                    },
                    "role": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Role",
                      "description": "The role granted by this permission; e.g., 'owner', 'organizer', 'fileOrganizer', 'writer', 'commenter', 'reader'."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Type",
                      "description": "The type of the permission; one of 'user', 'group', 'domain', or 'anyone'."
                    },
                    "domain": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Domain",
                      "description": "The domain the permission applies to. Only present for 'domain' type."
                    },
                    "photoLink": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Photo Link",
                      "format": "uri",
                      "maxLength": 2083,
                      "minLength": 1,
                      "description": "A link to the user's or group's profile photo."
                    },
                    "displayName": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Display Name",
                      "description": "The name of the user or group the permission applies to."
                    },
                    "emailAddress": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Email Address",
                      "description": "The email address of the user or group the permission applies to. Only present for 'user' or 'group' type."
                    },
                    "expirationTime": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Expiration Time",
                      "format": "date-time",
                      "description": "The time at which this permission will expire (RFC 3339 date-time)."
                    },
                    "permissionDetails": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "title": "GoogleDrivePermissionDetail",
                        "properties": {
                          "role": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Role",
                            "description": "The role granted by this permission for the given 'permissionType'."
                          },
                          "inherited": {
                            "type": "boolean",
                            "title": "Inherited",
                            "description": "Whether this permission is inherited."
                          },
                          "inheritedFrom": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Inherited From",
                            "description": "The ID of the source where this permission is inherited from."
                          },
                          "permissionType": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "title": "Permission Type",
                            "description": "The type of the permission; either 'member' or 'file'."
                          }
                        }
                      },
                      "title": "Permission Details",
                      "description": "Details of permission inheritance for shared drive items."
                    },
                    "allowFileDiscovery": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "title": "Allow File Discovery",
                      "description": "Whether the permission allows the file to be discovered through search. Only applicable to 'anyone' and 'domain' types."
                    }
                  }
                },
                "title": "Permissions",
                "description": "The full list of permissions for the file. Only returned if requested; may be empty or omitted if the requesting user lacks access."
              },
              "resourceKey": {
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_GENERATE_IDS
Generates a set of file IDs which can be provided in create or copy requests. Use when you need to pre-allocate IDs for new files or copies.

**Input schema:**

```json
      "minimum": 1,
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_ABOUT
Tool to retrieve information about the user, the user's Drive, and system capabilities. Use when you need to check storage quotas, user details, or supported import/export formats. Note: storageQuota reflects My Drive (personal) storage only — it does not cover shared drives; use GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_SHARED_DRIVES and GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_DRIVE for shared drive quotas. A successful response confirms base Drive read access only; write access and shared drive access must be verified separately.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAboutRequest",
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "*",
      "examples": [
        "*",
        "user,storageQuota",
        "user,storageQuota,kind"
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Use `*` to include all fields. Supported fields in Drive API v3: kind, user, storageQuota, importFormats, exportFormats, maxImportSizes, maxUploadSize, appInstalled, canCreateDrives, canCreateTeamDrives (deprecated), driveThemes, teamDriveThemes (deprecated), folderColorPalette. Note: rootFolderId was removed in v3 and is not supported. Note: storageQuota sub-fields (limit, usage, usageInDrive, usageInDriveTrash) are returned as strings representing bytes \u2014 convert to numeric types before arithmetic.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Fields to include",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which details you want returned. Use '*' to include everything, or provide a comma-separated list of supported fields. Supported fields: kind, user, storageQuota, importFormats, exportFormats, maxImportSizes, maxUploadSize, appInstalled, canCreateDrives, driveThemes, folderColorPalette."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_CHANGE

## GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_CHANGES_START_PAGE_TOKEN
Tool to get the starting pageToken for listing future changes in Google Drive. Returns only a token — pass it to GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_CHANGES to retrieve actual changes. Persist this token; losing it requires a full rescan. The token is forward-looking: GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_CHANGES may return no results if no changes have occurred since issuance. For simple recent-file lookups, prefer GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE; use this tool only for incremental change-feed workflows.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetChangesStartPageTokenRequest",
  "properties": {
    "driveId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "0AB_CD1234EFG5HIJ6KLM7N8PQRST9UVWX"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the shared drive for which the starting pageToken for listing future changes from that shared drive will be returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Drive ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The identifier of the shared drive you want to monitor for future changes. Leave this empty to track your own My Drive instead."
    },
    "teamDriveId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "0AB_CD1234EFG5HIJ6KLM7N8PQRST9UVWX"
      ],
      "description": "Deprecated: Use driveId instead.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Legacy name for the shared drive ID. Prefer 'Drive ID' above; only use this if an older workflow specifically asks for it."
    },
    "supportsAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to false.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Supports both My Drives and shared drives?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enable this if you want to include both your personal My Drive and any shared drives when tracking changes. Turn it on if you're working across shared spaces."
    },
    "supportsTeamDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports Team Drives",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Deprecated: Use supportsAllDrives instead.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Legacy option for shared drives; you can ignore this and use 'Supports both My Drives and shared drives?' instead. Only use it if required by an older setup."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_DRIVE
Tool to get a shared drive by ID. Use when you need to retrieve information about a specific shared drive. To discover drive_ids, use GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_SHARED_DRIVES first; GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_ABOUT reflects overall user storage, not individual shared drive details. Permission changes may have a brief propagation delay before appearing in results.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetDriveRequest",
  "required": [
    "drive_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "drive_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "0ABCA123456789"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the shared drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Drive ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the shared drive you want to look up. You can copy this from the drive\u2019s URL in Google Drive."
    },
    "use_domain_admin_access": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Domain Admin Access",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Issue the request as a domain administrator; if set to true, then the requester will be granted access if they are an administrator of the domain to which the shared drive belongs.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Use domain admin access?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on if you\u2019re a Google Workspace admin who needs to access drives across your organization. Use it when the drive isn\u2019t directly shared with you but you have admin rights."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_FILE_METADATA
Tool to get a file's metadata by ID. Use to verify `mimeType`, `parents`, and `trashed` status before destructive operations (delete/move/export), or to confirm `mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.document'` before calling GOOGLEDOCS_* tools (non-native files require GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE). Only returns metadata visible to the connected account; public access requires GOOGLEDRIVE_ADD_FILE_SHARING_PREFERENCE. High-frequency calls risk `403 rateLimitExceeded`; apply exponential backoff.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetFileMetadataRequest",
  "required": [
    "fileId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Use this for partial responses to request only specific metadata fields. Common fields: id, name, mimeType, webViewLink, webContentLink, createdTime, modifiedTime, size, quotaBytesUsed, parents, owners, permissions. Use '*' to return all available fields. Note: The deprecated v2 field 'alternateLink' is automatically migrated to 'webViewLink'. Example: 'id,name,mimeType,webViewLink,createdTime,modifiedTime'. Most fields (webViewLink, parents, owners, size, modifiedTime, etc.) are omitted by default \u2014 explicitly list required fields or use '*' (increases latency). `md5Checksum` is null for native Google Workspace files (Docs/Sheets/Slides); use `mimeType` to classify items \u2014 folders use `mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder'` and Workspace files return `size=null`. `modifiedTime` is RFC 3339 UTC format.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Specify which metadata fields to return, separated by commas. Leave blank for default fields (kind, id, name, mimeType). Use 'id,name,mimeType,webViewLink' to include the file's web link, or '*' for all fields. The deprecated v2 field 'alternateLink' is automatically converted to 'webViewLink'."
    },
    "fileId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j"
      ],
      "description": "The Google Drive file ID (an opaque alphanumeric string like '1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j'), NOT a file name. If you only have a file name, use GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE or GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_FILES to get the file ID first.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique Google Drive file ID (an alphanumeric string without spaces or file extensions). This is NOT a file name. If you only have a file name like 'document.pdf', use GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE first to get the file ID. File IDs can be found in the file's URL after '/d/' or by listing/searching files."
    },
    "includeLabels": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Include Labels",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the labelInfo part of the response.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include labels",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the label IDs you want returned with the file's details, separated by commas. Leave blank if you don't need label information."
    },
    "supportsAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to true to ensure files in shared drives are accessible.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Supports all drives?",
      "human_parameter_description": "When true (the default), the action can access files in both My Drive and shared drives. Set to false only if you specifically want to restrict access to My Drive."
    },
    "includePermissionsForView": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Include Permissions For View",
      "description": "Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response. Only 'published' is supported.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include permissions for view",
      "human_parameter_description": "Include permissions for a specific viewing context. Set to 'published' if you need who can see the file via a published link; otherwise leave blank."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_FILE_PROPERTY
Tool to get a property by its key using Google Drive API v2. Use when you need to retrieve a specific custom property attached to a file.

**Input schema:**

```json
  "required": [
    "fileId",
    "propertyKey"
  ],

      "type": "string",

      "examples": [

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Property Key",

      ],
      "description": "The key of the property."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_PARENT
Tool to get a specific parent reference for a file using Drive API v2. Use when you need to retrieve information about a specific parent folder of a file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetParentRequest",
  "required": [
    "fileId",
    "parentId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "alt": {
      "enum": [
        "json",
        "media",
        "proto"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AltEnum",
      "description": "Data format for response."
    },
    "key": {

        "2"
      ],

      "title": "Fields",
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_PERMISSION
Gets a permission by ID. Use this tool to retrieve a specific permission for a file or shared drive. Newly created or updated permissions on shared drives may have a brief propagation delay before appearing.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPermissionRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "permission_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "id,emailAddress,displayName,role,permissionDetails"
      ],
      "description": "Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. Use 'fields=*' to return all available fields for the permission resource.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which permission details to return. Use 'fields=*' for everything, or list specific fields (e.g., 'id,role,emailAddress') to keep the response concise."
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the file whose permission you want to look up. You can copy it from the file's URL in Drive."
    },
    "permission_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Permission Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345678901234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The numeric ID of the permission. Note: The 'me' alias is NOT supported by the Google Drive permissions API. You must provide an actual numeric permission ID (e.g., '12345678901234567890'). Use the LIST_PERMISSIONS action to get permission IDs for a file.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Permission ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The numeric permission ID to look up. Important: 'me' is NOT supported - you must use an actual permission ID. Use LIST_PERMISSIONS on the file first to get the permission IDs."
    },
    "supports_all_drives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Supports all drives?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on if the file might be in a shared drive. It ensures the request works for both My Drive and shared drives."
    },
    "use_domain_admin_access": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Domain Admin Access",
      "description": "Issue the request as a domain administrator; if set to true, then the requester will be granted access if the file ID parameter refers to a shared drive and the requester is an administrator of the domain to which the shared drive belongs.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Use domain admin access?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enable this if you are a Google Workspace domain admin and need to use admin privileges to access permissions on shared drive files."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_REVISION
Tool to get a specific revision's metadata (name, modifiedTime, keepForever, etc.) by revision ID. Returns metadata only — not file content. Use a separate download tool to retrieve file content or restore a revision.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetRevisionRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "revision_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1ZdR3L3Kek7szY1G1-2VUX8cW6CnU0c4a"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the ID of the file whose revision you want to view. You can copy it from the file's URL or from a previous search or list step."
    },
    "revision_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Revision Id",
      "examples": [
        "0B9B5CLMDv-N4Z2FhY0E5RUQzNVE"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the revision.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Revision ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the ID of the specific revision of the file you want details for. You can get this from a prior 'list revisions' step or other metadata lookup."
    },
    "acknowledge_abuse": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Acknowledge Abuse",
      "description": "Whether the user is acknowledging the risk of downloading known malware or other abusive files. This is only applicable when the alt parameter is set to media and the user is the owner of the file or an organizer of the shared drive in which the file resides.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Acknowledge abuse?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on only if you understand the file may be unsafe and you still want to proceed. Enable it when you're sure you trust the source and need to access the file."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_GOOGLE_DRIVE_DELETE_FOLDER_OR_FILE_ACTION
Tool to delete a file or folder in Google Drive. Use when you need to permanently remove a specific file or folder using its ID. Note: This action is irreversible. Deleting a folder permanently removes all nested files and subfolders.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GoogleDriveDeleteFolderOrFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "fileId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fileId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1XyZAbcDefGhiJklMnoPqRsTuVwXyZAbcDef"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file or folder to delete. This is a required field.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the unique ID of the file or folder you want to delete. You can copy it from the item's Google Drive link so we know exactly which item to remove."
    },
    "supportsAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "description": "Whether the application supports both My Drives and shared drives. If false or unspecified, the file is attempted to be deleted from the user's My Drive. If true, the item will be deleted from shared drives as well if necessary.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Supports all drives?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to include Shared Drives as well as My Drive when deleting. Turn this on if the item might be in a Shared Drive."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "GoogleDriveDeleteFolderOrFileResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "GoogleDriveDeleteFolderOrFileResponse",
      "required": [
        "display_url",
        "link_label"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "link_label": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Link Label",
          "description": "Human-readable label for the display URL link"
        },
        "display_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Display Url",
          "description": "URL to view the file in Google Drive (points to the deleted file location)"
        }
      },
      "description": "Response model for Google Drive files.delete.\nOfficial API returns no response body (HTTP 204 No Content) on success.\nThis model includes display_url and link_label for UI integration.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "title": "GoogleDriveDeleteFolderOrFileResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "display_url",
        "link_label"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "link_label": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Link Label",
          "description": "Human-readable label for the display URL link"
        },
        "display_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Display Url",
          "description": "URL to view the file in Google Drive (points to the deleted file location)"
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_HIDE_DRIVE
Tool to hide a shared drive from the default view. Use when you want to remove a shared drive from the user's main Google Drive interface without deleting it.

```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "HideDriveRequest",
  "required": [
    "drive_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "drive_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [

      "description": "The ID of the shared drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Drive ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the shared drive you want to hide. You can find it in the drive's URL or from a previous list of drives."
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_INSERT_CHILD
Tool to insert a file into a folder using Drive API v2. Use when you need to add an existing file to a folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "InsertChildRequest",
  "required": [
    "folderId",
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "19GP5DRpUcmQHBVnk39RTB57twIWVEMjO"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the child file to insert into the folder."
    },
    "alt": {
      "enum": [
        "json",
        "media",
        "proto"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AltEnum",
      "description": "Data format for response."
    },
    "key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Key",
      "description": "API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token."
    },
    "xgafv": {
      "enum": [
        "1",
        "2"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "XgafvEnum",
      "description": "V1 error format options."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response."
    },
    "callback": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Callback",
      "description": "JSONP callback parameter."
    },
    "folderId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "1IL1JRSfkm9B_L-guI7g-birKApFyD_Di"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the folder."
    },
    "quotaUser": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quota User",
      "description": "Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters."
    },
    "uploadType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Upload Type",
      "description": "Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. 'media', 'multipart')."
    },
    "oauth_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Oauth Token",
      "description": "OAuth 2.0 token for the current user."
    },
    "prettyPrint": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pretty Print",
      "description": "Returns response with indentations and line breaks."
    },
    "access_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Access Token",
      "description": "OAuth access token."
    },
    "upload_protocol": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Upload Protocol",
      "description": "Upload protocol for media (e.g. 'raw', 'multipart')."
    },
    "supportsAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives."
    },
    "supportsTeamDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports Team Drives",
      "description": "Deprecated: Use supportsAllDrives instead."
    },
    "enforceSingleParent": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Enforce Single Parent",
      "description": "Deprecated: Adding files to multiple folders is no longer supported. Use shortcuts instead."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_ACCESS_PROPOSALS

## GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_CHANGES
Tool to list the changes for a user or shared drive. Use when a full incremental change feed is needed (for simple recent-file lookups, prefer GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE instead). Tracks modifications such as creations, deletions, or permission changes. The pageToken is optional - if not provided, the current start page token will be automatically fetched; an empty result is valid if no recent activity has occurred. Example usage: ```json { "pageToken": "22633", "pageSize": 100, "includeRemoved": true } ``` Returns changes with timestamps, file IDs, and modification details. Paginate by following `nextPageToken` until it is absent — stopping early will silently omit changes. Save `newStartPageToken` to monitor future changes efficiently.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListChangesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "spaces": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Spaces",
      "default": "drive",
      "examples": [
        "drive,appDataFolder"
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of spaces to query within the corpora. Supported values are 'drive' and 'appDataFolder'.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Spaces",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which areas to search. Use 'drive' for regular files; add 'appDataFolder' to include app-specific hidden data."
    },
    "driveId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "0AB1CDEfghijklmNOP"
      ],
      "description": "The shared drive from which changes will be returned. If specified the change IDs will be reflective of the shared drive; use the combined drive ID and change ID as an identifier. When driveId is provided, supportsAllDrives is automatically set to true.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Drive ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the ID of the shared drive you want to monitor. Leave this empty to check your own My Drive."
    },
    "pageSize": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 100,
      "maximum": 1000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        100
      ],
      "description": "The maximum number of changes to return per page.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many change records to return in one batch. Larger numbers mean fewer pages but may take longer to load."
    },
    "pageToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page Token",
      "examples": [
        "22633"
      ],
      "description": "The token for continuing a previous list request on the next page. Must be a valid token from a previous LIST_CHANGES response's 'nextPageToken' field or from the get_changes_start_page_token action. If not provided, the current start page token will be automatically fetched and used. Tokens can become stale \u2014 always use a fresh token from GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_CHANGES_START_PAGE_TOKEN or the most recent prior response to avoid missed or duplicate changes. Paginate until nextPageToken is absent; stopping early silently omits changes.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Token",
      "human_parameter_description": "Paste the token from your last changes request to continue from that point. Leave empty for the first call to automatically start monitoring from now."
    },
    "includeLabels": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Include Labels",
      "examples": [
        "labelId1,labelId2"
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the `labelInfo` part of the response.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Labels",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide label IDs (comma-separated) whose details you want included with each item. Leave empty to skip labels."
    },
    "includeRemoved": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Removed",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether to include changes indicating that items have been removed from the list of changes, for example by deletion or loss of access.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Removed?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Include events where items were deleted or you lost access, so you can track removals."
    },
    "restrictToMyDrive": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Restrict To My Drive",
      "description": "Whether to restrict the results to changes inside the My Drive hierarchy. This omits changes to files such as those in the Application Data folder or shared files which have not been added to My Drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Restrict To My Drive?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Show only changes within your My Drive. This excludes app data and files not added to My Drive."
    },
    "supportsAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Must be true when driveId is specified (will be automatically set to true when driveId is provided).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Supports All Drives?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set this if you use shared drives so results can include both My Drive and shared drives."
    },
    "includeCorpusRemovals": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Corpus Removals",
      "description": "Whether changes should include the file resource if the file is still accessible by the user at the time of the request, even when a file was removed from the list of changes and there will be no further change entries for this file. Note: When set to true, includeRemoved must also be true (will be automatically set).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Corpus Removals?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on to also return items that were removed from the change feed but that you can still access, so you can see their current details."
    },
    "includeItemsFromAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Items From All Drives",

      "human_parameter_name": "Include Permissions For View",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter a view name (like 'published') to include related permission details in the results. Most users can leave this empty."
    }
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_COMMENTS
Tool to list all comments for a file in Google Drive. Results are paginated; iterate using nextPageToken until absent to retrieve all comments. Filtering by author, content, or other criteria must be done client-side. Use commentId, createdTime, and author from results to uniquely identify comments before acting on them.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListCommentsRequest",
  "required": [
    "fileId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "*",
      "examples": [
        "*",
        "comments(id,content,author)"
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Use `*` to include all fields. Prefer selective field masks (e.g., 'comments(id,content,author)') over '*' to reduce payload size and latency.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which comment details to return. Use '*' to include everything, or specify only the fields you need."
    },
    "fileId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file. Equivalent to the Google Docs document_id; pass it here under the fileId parameter name.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the Google Drive file whose comments you want to list. You can copy this from the file's URL."
    },
    "pageSize": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 20,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The maximum number of comments to return per page.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many comments to return in one page of results. Larger numbers show more at once (maximum 100)."
    },
    "pageToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page Token",
      "description": "The token for continuing a previous list request on the next page. This should be set to the value of 'nextPageToken' from the previous response. Comments may be added or modified during pagination on active files; use startModifiedTime to bound the window if consistency is required.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page token",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you're continuing from a previous list, paste the nextPageToken from that response to get the next page."
    },
    "includeDeleted": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Deleted",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to include deleted comments. Deleted comments will not include their original content.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include deleted comments?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to include comments that were deleted. Deleted comments will appear without their original text."
    },
    "startModifiedTime": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Modified Time",
      "description": "The minimum value of 'modifiedTime' for the result comments (RFC 3339 date-time).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Start modified time",
      "human_parameter_description": "Only show comments updated on or after this date and time. Helpful for fetching recent changes."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_FILE_LABELS
Tool to list the labels already applied to a file in Google Drive. An empty labels array is a valid response indicating no labels are applied, not an error. This tool shows only applied labels; label_id and field_id values required by other Drive label tools must be obtained from admin configuration.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFileLabelsRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ0123456789"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the Google Drive file whose labels you want to see. You can copy it from the file's URL."
    },
    "page_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page Token",
      "description": "Token to retrieve a specific page of results.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page token",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you're continuing from a previous list, paste the token to fetch the next page. Leave empty to start from the beginning."
    },
    "max_results": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Max Results",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The maximum number of labels to return per page. Default is 100.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Maximum results",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many labels to show per page. Leave blank to use the default."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_FILES
DEPRECATED: Use GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE instead. Tool to list a user's files and folders in Google Drive. Use this to search or browse for files and folders based on various criteria.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFilesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Q",
      "examples": [
        "name contains 'report' and starred = true"
      ],
      "description": "A query string for filtering the file results. Supports operators 'and', 'or', 'not'. VALID query terms: 'name' (contains, =, !=), 'fullText' (contains), 'mimeType' (contains, =, !=), 'modifiedTime' (<=, <, =, !=, >, >=), 'viewedByMeTime' (<=, <, =, !=, >, >=), 'trashed' (=, !=), 'starred' (=, !=), 'parents' (in), 'owners' (in), 'writers' (in), 'readers' (in), 'sharedWithMe' (=, !=), 'createdTime' (<=, <, =, !=, >, >=), 'properties' (has), 'appProperties' (has), 'visibility' (=, !=), 'shortcutDetails.targetId' (=, !=). IMPORTANT: 'id' is NOT a valid query term - you cannot search by file ID using this parameter. To get a specific file by ID, use the 'Get File Metadata' action instead. LENGTH LIMITS: Very long queries (especially with many parent folder IDs or fullText clauses) may exceed Google's URL size limits and result in errors. If searching across many folders (e.g., 100+ parent IDs), consider splitting into multiple smaller queries. Example: \"name contains 'important' and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder'\".",
      "human_parameter_name": "Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Filter the results using a search query (for example by name, type, or date). Use this to narrow down to exactly the files you're looking for."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "id,name,mimeType",
        "id,name,mimeType,webViewLink,modifiedTime"
      ],
      "description": "Selector specifying which file fields to include in the response. Provide a comma-separated list of file field names (e.g., 'id,name,mimeType,webViewLink'). The action will automatically format this into the proper API format 'files(field1,field2,...)'. Common file fields include: id, name, description, mimeType, webViewLink, webContentLink, size, createdTime, modifiedTime, parents, owners, permissions. To also include the pagination token, add 'nextPageToken' to the list. NOTE: Google Drive API v2 field names are automatically converted to v3 equivalents (e.g., alternateLink\u2192webViewLink, downloadUrl\u2192webContentLink, title\u2192name, createdDate\u2192createdTime, modifiedDate\u2192modifiedTime).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Pick only the data you want back to make responses smaller and faster (e.g., id, name, mimeType). Helpful when you don't need full file details."
    },
    "spaces": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Spaces",
      "examples": [
        "drive,appDataFolder"
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of spaces to query within the corpora. Supported values are 'drive' and 'appDataFolder'. 'drive' represents files in My Drive and shared drives, while 'appDataFolder' represents the application's private data folder.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Spaces",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which storage area to search, such as regular Drive files or the app\u2019s private data folder. Most users should use 'drive' unless you specifically need app data."
    },
    "corpora": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Corpora",
      "examples": [
        "user",
        "drive"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies the bodies of items (files/documents) to which the query applies. Supported values are 'user', 'domain', 'drive', and 'allDrives'. It's generally more efficient to use 'user' or 'drive' instead of 'allDrives'. Defaults to 'user'.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Corpora",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose where to look for files (your drive, a specific shared drive, your domain, or all drives). If you're unsure, leave it as 'user' to search your own files."
    },
    "driveId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "0ABCA123456789"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the shared drive to search. This is used when `corpora` is set to 'drive'.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Drive ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The identifier of the shared drive you want to search. Paste the ID from the shared drive\u2019s URL when targeting a specific shared drive."
    },
    "orderBy": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Order By",
      "examples": [
        "modifiedTime desc,name",
        "quotaBytesUsed desc"
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of sort keys. Valid keys are: 'createdTime', 'folder', 'modifiedByMeTime', 'modifiedTime', 'name', 'name_natural', 'quotaBytesUsed', 'recency', 'sharedWithMeTime', 'starred', 'viewedByMeTime'. IMPORTANT: Use 'quotaBytesUsed' to sort by file size (do NOT use 'size' - it is not a valid key). Each key sorts in ascending order by default, but can be reversed with the 'desc' modifier (e.g., 'modifiedTime desc').",
      "human_parameter_name": "Order by",
      "human_parameter_description": "How you want the results sorted (for example by name or last modified). Use 'quotaBytesUsed' for file size. You can combine multiple sort keys and use 'desc' to reverse the order."
    },
    "folderId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"
      ],
      "description": "ID of a specific folder to list files from. This is a convenience parameter that automatically adds \"'folder_id' in parents\" to the query. Cannot be used together with a custom 'q' parameter.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Folder ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific folder you want to list files from. Paste the folder ID from its URL to see only the items inside that folder."
    },
    "pageSize": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 100,
      "maximum": 1000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        50
      ],
      "description": "The maximum number of files to return per page. The value must be between 1 and 1000, inclusive. Defaults to 100.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many items to return per page. Use a larger number to get more results in one go."
    },
    "pageToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page Token",
      "examples": [
        " nextPageTokenValue"
      ],
      "description": "The token for continuing a previous list request on the next page. This MUST be set to the value of 'nextPageToken' from the previous response. Do not manually construct or modify pageToken values as they are opaque tokens generated by the API. If the token is rejected, pagination should be restarted from the first page.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page token",
      "human_parameter_description": "Use this to continue from a previous page of results. Copy the nextPageToken from your last response to get the next set of files."
    },
    "includeLabels": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Include Labels",
      "examples": [

      "description": "A comma-separated list of label IDs to include in the `labelInfo` part of the response for each file.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include labels",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add labels to each file in the results by specifying the label IDs. Use this if you rely on labels to organize or filter files."

    "supportsAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",

      ],
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to false. If true, then `includeItemsFromAllDrives` can be used to extend the search to all drives.",

      "title": "Include Items From All Drives",

      "description": "Whether to include items from both My Drive and shared drives. This is relevant when `corpora` is 'user' or 'domain'. Defaults to false.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include items from all drives?",
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_REPLIES
Tool to list replies to a comment in Google Drive. Use this when you need to retrieve all replies associated with a specific comment on a file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListRepliesRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "comment_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "*",
      "description": "Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. Use '*' for all fields or e.g. 'replies(id,content),nextPageToken'",
      "human_parameter_name": "Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which details to include in the results. Leave as '*' to get everything, or specify only what you need to keep responses smaller."
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345abcdef"
      ],
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_REVISIONS
Tool to list a file's revision metadata (not content) in Google Drive. Drive may prune old revisions, so history may be incomplete for frequently edited files. Filter client-side for specific revisionIds; do not assume the last entry is the active version.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListRevisionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "fileId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fileId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the Google Drive file whose revisions you want to view. You can copy this from the file's URL."
    },
    "pageSize": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "maximum": 1000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        100
      ],
      "description": "The maximum number of revisions to return per page.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Maximum number of revisions to return",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many revisions to show at once. Choose a smaller number for easier browsing or a larger number to see more results per page."
    },
    "pageToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page Token",
      "examples": [
        "abcdef123456"
      ],
      "description": "The token for continuing a previous list request on the next page. This should be set to the value of 'nextPageToken' from the previous response. Continue paginating until `nextPageToken` is absent; stopping early silently omits revisions.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page token for next page",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you're continuing from a previous list, paste the next page token you received to load the following set of revisions. Leave blank to start from the first page."
    },
    "supportsAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to false. Must be set to `true` for shared drive files; omitting it causes `fileId` resolution failures on shared drives.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Does the application support all drives?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on if the file might be in a shared drive so we can find its revisions there too. Leave it off if you only use My Drive."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_SHARED_DRIVES
Tool to list the user's shared drives. Use when you need to get a list of all shared drives accessible to the authenticated user. Results may differ from the web UI due to admin policies; listing a drive does not guarantee access to its contents. Paginated calls may trigger 403 rateLimitExceeded or 429 tooManyRequests; apply exponential backoff when iterating many pages.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListSharedDrivesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Q",
      "description": "Query string for searching shared drives using Google Drive query syntax (e.g., \"name contains 'ProjectX'\" or \"createdTime > '2023-01-01T00:00:00'\"). Query format: query_term operator values. Common query terms: name, createdTime, memberCount, organizerCount, hidden. Common operators: contains, =, >, <, >=, !=. String values must be enclosed in single quotes. Special characters (apostrophes, backslashes) must be escaped. Multiple terms can be combined with 'and'/'or' operators and parentheses for grouping.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Search query",
      "human_parameter_description": "A search query using Google Drive's query syntax to filter shared drives. Format: query_term operator values. Examples: \"name contains 'Marketing'\" to find drives with 'Marketing' in the name, or \"hidden = false\" to show only visible drives. Leave blank to see all drives you have access to."
    },
    "pageSize": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Maximum number of shared drives to return per page. Maximum allowed value is 1000. Paginate by passing the returned nextPageToken back as pageToken until no nextPageToken is returned to avoid silently missing drives.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many shared drives to show in one page of results. Choose a smaller number for quicker previews or the maximum (up to 100) to see more at once."
    },
    "pageToken": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Page Token",
      "description": "Page token for shared drives.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page token",
      "human_parameter_description": "Use this token to continue from where the last page left off. You usually get it from a previous list call when there are more results."
    },
    "useDomainAdminAccess": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Domain Admin Access",
      "description": "Issue the request as a domain administrator. If set to true, then all shared drives of the domain in which the requester is an administrator are returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Use domain admin access?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on if you're a Google Workspace admin and want to list all shared drives in your domain, not just the ones you can access directly. Leave it off for regular personal results."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_MODIFY_FILE_LABELS
Modifies the set of labels applied to a file. Returns a list of the labels that were added or modified. Use when you need to programmatically change labels on a Google Drive file, such as adding, updating, or removing them.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ModifyFileLabelsRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "label_modifications"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Kind",
      "default": "drive#modifyLabelsRequest",
      "description": "This is always drive#modifyLabelsRequest.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Identifies the type of request. You can leave this as-is; it's set automatically."
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "description": "The ID of the file.",
      "human_parameter_description": "The identifier of the Google Drive file whose labels you want to change. You can copy the ID from the file's URL."
    },
    "label_modifications": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "LabelModification",
        "required": [
          "labelId"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Kind",
            "default": "drive#labelModification",
            "description": "This is always drive#labelModification."
          },
          "labelId": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Label Id",
            "examples": [
              "kAAAAAYXH8G2W_3a5Pl5gQ"
            ],
            "description": "The internal label ID (NOT the label's display name). Must be a bare alphanumeric ID without any prefix (do NOT include 'labels/'). Obtain valid IDs using files.listLabels or the Drive Labels API."
          },
          "removeLabel": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Remove Label",
            "description": "If true, the label will be removed from the file."
          },
          "fieldModifications": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "FieldModification",
              "required": [
                "fieldId"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "kind": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Kind",
                  "default": "drive#labelFieldModification",
                  "description": "This is always drive#labelFieldModification."
                },
                "fieldId": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Field Id",
                  "examples": [
                    "kAAAAAHqPWmn9klX4RG_vA"
                  ],
                  "description": "The internal field ID from the label schema (NOT the field's display name). Must be a bare alphanumeric ID. Obtain valid IDs using files.listLabels or the Drive Labels API."
                },
                "unsetValues": {
                  "type": "boolean",
                  "title": "Unset Values",
                  "description": "Unsets the values for this field."
                },
                "setDateValues": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  "title": "Set Date Values",
                  "examples": [
                    "2023-10-26"
                  ],
                  "description": "Replaces the value of a `date` field with these new values. The string must be in the RFC 3339 full-date format: YYYY-MM-DD."
                },
                "setTextValues": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  "title": "Set Text Values",
                  "description": "Sets the value of a `text` field."
                },
                "setUserValues": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  "title": "Set User Values",
                  "description": "Replaces a `user` field with these new values. The values must be valid email addresses."
                },
                "setIntegerValues": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  "title": "Set Integer Values",
                  "description": "Replaces the value of an `integer` field with these new values."
                },
                "setSelectionValues": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  "title": "Set Selection Values",
                  "description": "Replaces a `selection` field with these new values."
                }
              }
            },
            "title": "Field Modifications",
            "description": "The list of modifications to this label's fields."
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Label Modifications",
      "description": "The list of modifications to apply to the labels on the file.",
      "human_parameter_description": "The changes you want to make to the file's labels\u2014add, update, or remove specific label fields. Provide one or more label modifications."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_MOVE_FILE
Tool to move a file from one folder to another in Google Drive. To truly move (not just copy the parent), always provide both `add_parents` (destination folder ID) and `remove_parents` (source folder ID); omitting `remove_parents` leaves the file in multiple folders. Useful for reorganizing files, including newly created Google Docs/Sheets that default to Drive root.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "MoveFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1XyZ..."
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file to move. Must be a non-empty string.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the file you want to move in Google Drive. You can copy it from the file's link or from a previous search or list result."
    },
    "add_parents": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Add Parents",
      "examples": [
        "1FmTIJYwTENUDXOKyNJp7OmcRBvP_6DmT"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the single destination folder (e.g., '1FmTIJYwTENUDXOKyNJp7OmcRBvP_6DmT'). Must be a valid Google Drive folder ID consisting of alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores. Folder names are not accepted.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Destination Folder ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The destination folder ID (like '1FmTIJYwTENUDXOKyNJp7OmcRBvP_6DmT'). Use GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FOLDER or GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_FILES to find the folder ID. Folder names are NOT accepted - you must provide the ID."
    },
    "ocr_language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ocr Language",
      "description": "A language hint for OCR processing during image import (ISO 639-1 code).",
      "human_parameter_name": "OCR Language",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you're importing an image or PDF and want text recognized, provide the language code (like 'en' or 'es'). This improves text detection accuracy."
    },
    "include_labels": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Include Labels",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the `labelInfo` part of the response.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Labels",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add specific label IDs to include label details in the result. Separate multiple IDs with commas if needed."
    },
    "remove_parents": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Remove Parents",
      "examples": [
        "folder_id_3,folder_id_4"
      ],
      "description": "A comma-separated list of parent folder IDs to remove the file from. Use this to specify the source folder.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Parent Folder IDs to Remove",
      "human_parameter_description": "The current folder(s) you want to remove the file from. Enter one or more folder IDs separated by commas to complete the move."
    },
    "supports_all_drives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Set to true if moving files to or from a shared drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Supports All Drives?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on if the file or destination is in a shared drive. It helps the move work across My Drive and shared drives."
    },
    "keep_revision_forever": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Keep Revision Forever",
      "description": "Whether to set the 'keepForever' field in the new head revision. This is only applicable to files with binary content in Google Drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Keep Revision Forever?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose this if you want the latest version of the file to be kept permanently as a revision. Useful for preserving a specific version of binary files."
    },
    "include_permissions_for_view": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Include Permissions For View",
      "description": "Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response. Only 'published' is supported.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Permissions for View",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you need permission info for a special view, choose which one to include (only 'published' is supported). Most users can leave this blank."
    },
    "use_content_as_indexable_text": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Content As Indexable Text",
      "description": "Whether to use the uploaded content as indexable text.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Use Content as Indexable Text?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enable if you want the file's content to be used for search indexing. This can make the file easier to find later."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_PARSE_FILE
DEPRECATED: Exports Google Workspace files (max 10MB) to a specified format using `mime_type`, or downloads other file types; use `GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE` instead.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ParseFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "description": "The unique ID of the file stored in Google Drive that you want to export or download.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the Google Drive file you want to export or download. You can copy it from the file\u2019s URL or use one returned by a previous search."
    },
    "mime_type": {
      "enum": [
        "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
        "application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text",

      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "MimeType",
      "examples": [
        "application/pdf",
        "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
        "text/csv"
      ],
      "description": "Target MIME type for exporting Google Workspace files only. Supported exports by source type: Google Docs -> DOCX, ODT, RTF, PDF, TXT, ZIP (HTML), EPUB, MD; Google Sheets -> XLSX, ODS, PDF, ZIP (HTML), CSV, TSV; Google Slides -> PPTX, ODP, PDF, TXT, JPG, PNG, SVG; Google Drawings -> PDF, JPG, PNG, SVG; Apps Script -> JSON. If omitted, a default format is used: Docs->PDF, Sheets->XLSX, Slides->PDF, Drawings->PDF. For non-Workspace files (PDFs, images, text files, etc.), this parameter is ignored and the file is downloaded in its native format.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Target MIME type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the format you want to export Google Workspace files to (for example, PDF, DOCX, or CSV). For Workspace files, if left blank, a default format is used (Docs->PDF, Sheets->XLSX, Slides->PDF). For regular files (PDFs, images, etc.), this is ignored and the original file is downloaded."
```
