## GOOGLEDRIVE_PATCH_PERMISSION
Tool to update a permission using patch semantics. Use when you need to modify specific fields of an existing permission without affecting other fields. **Warning:** Concurrent permissions operations on the same file are not supported; only the last update is applied.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PatchPermissionRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "permission_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "role": {
      "enum": [
        "owner",
        "organizer",
        "fileOrganizer",
        "writer",
        "reader"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "PermissionRole",
      "examples": [
        "reader",
        "writer"
      ],
      "description": "Permission roles that can be granted in Google Drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Role",
      "human_parameter_description": "The access level to grant: 'reader' for view-only, 'writer' to edit, 'owner' to transfer ownership."
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1FT9IW4UpvEc4Ezxv8xS2jEda17MztBXzK7CMqfz-s98"
      ],
      "description": "The ID for the file or shared drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the file or shared drive whose permission you want to update. You can find it in the file's URL in Google Drive."
    },
    "with_link": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "With Link",
      "description": "Whether the link is required for this permission. Set to true for 'anyone with the link' access (not publicly discoverable), or false for publicly discoverable access.",
      "human_parameter_name": "With Link",
      "human_parameter_description": "For 'anyone' permissions: set to true for 'anyone with the link' (not searchable), or false for fully public access."
    },
    "permission_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Permission Id",
      "examples": [
        "anyone",
        "anyoneWithLink",
        "18394857362947583"
      ],
      "description": "The ID for the permission. Use 'anyone' for public link permissions, or specific permission IDs for user/group/domain permissions. You can get permission IDs by calling GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_PERMISSIONS.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Permission ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the permission you want to update. Use 'anyone' for public link permissions, or get specific IDs from the List Permissions action."
    },
    "expiration_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expiration Date",
      "examples": [
        "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"
      ],
      "description": "The time at which this permission will expire (RFC 3339 date-time). Can only be set on user and group permissions. The date must be in the future and cannot be more than a year in the future.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Expiration Date",
      "human_parameter_description": "When this permission should expire in RFC 3339 format (e.g., '2024-12-31T23:59:59Z'). Only works for user and group permissions."
    },
    "additional_roles": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Additional Roles",
      "examples": [
        [
          "commenter"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Additional roles for this user. Only 'commenter' is currently allowed.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Additional Roles",
      "human_parameter_description": "Extra roles beyond the primary role. Currently only 'commenter' is supported."
    },
    "remove_expiration": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Remove Expiration",
      "description": "Whether to remove the expiration date. Set to true to make the permission permanent.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Remove Expiration",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set to true to remove any expiration date and make this permission permanent."
    },
    "transfer_ownership": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Transfer Ownership",
      "description": "Whether changing a role to 'owner' downgrades the current owners to writers. Does nothing if the specified role is not 'owner'. Required as an acknowledgement when transferring ownership.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Transfer Ownership",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set to true to transfer ownership of the file to the specified user. The current owner becomes a writer. Use with caution."
    },
    "supports_all_drives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Supports All Drives",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enable this if the file might be in a shared drive so the operation works for both My Drive and shared drives."
    },
    "use_domain_admin_access": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Domain Admin Access",
      "description": "Issue the request as a domain administrator; if set to true, then the requester will be granted access if the file ID parameter refers to a shared drive and the requester is an administrator of the domain to which the shared drive belongs.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Use Domain Admin Access",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you're a domain admin, enable this to use admin privileges when updating the permission, especially for shared drives."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_PATCH_PROPERTY
Tool to update a property on a file using PATCH semantics (v2 API). Use when you need to partially update custom key-value metadata attached to a Google Drive file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PatchPropertyRequest",
  "required": [
    "fileId",
    "propertyKey"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "alt": {
      "enum": [
        "json",
        "media",
        "proto"
      ],
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_RESUMABLE_UPLOAD
Tool to start and complete a Google Drive resumable upload session. Use for files larger than ~5 MB to avoid timeouts or size-limit failures. HTTP 308 means continue the session from the correct byte offset; HTTP 410 means the session expired and a full restart with a new session is required.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ResumableUploadRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_to_upload"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "description": "Optional file ID if updating an existing file instead of creating a new one."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "description": "JSON metadata for the Drive File resource (e.g., {'name': 'photo.jpg', 'parents': ['folderId']}). To convert to a Google Docs MIME type, set metadata.mimeType to the target Docs type but send the real file MIME type as the upload content type \u2014 using the Docs MIME type as upload content type causes invalidContentType errors.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "chunkSize": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Chunk Size",
      "default": 262144,
      "minimum": 262144,
      "examples": [
        262144
      ],
      "description": "Chunk size in bytes; must be a multiple of 256 KB."
    },
    "queryParams": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Query Params",
      "properties": {
        "uploadType": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "resumable",
          "title": "Upload Type",
          "default": "resumable",
          "description": "Must be 'resumable'."
        },
        "ocrLanguage": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Ocr Language",
          "description": "ISO 639-1 code to hint OCR during image import."
        },
        "includeLabels": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Include Labels",
          "description": "Comma-separated label IDs to include in labelInfo."
        },
        "supportsAllDrives": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Supports All Drives",
          "description": "Whether the app supports both My Drive and shared drives."
        },
        "keepRevisionForever": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Keep Revision Forever",
          "description": "Whether to set keepForever on the new head revision."
        },
        "ignoreDefaultVisibility": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Ignore Default Visibility",
          "description": "Bypass domain default visibility for the created file."
        },
        "includePermissionsForView": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "published",
          "title": "Include Permissions For View",
          "description": "Which additional view's permissions to include; only 'published' supported."
        },
        "useContentAsIndexableText": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Use Content As Indexable Text",
          "description": "Whether to use uploaded content as indexable text."
        }
      },
      "description": "Optional Drive query parameters.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "file_to_upload": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "File to upload to Google Drive via resumable upload.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "folder_to_upload_to": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder To Upload To",
      "description": "Optional folder ID where NEW files should be uploaded. Only used during file creation, not updates. Will be added to metadata.parents. Must reference a valid, non-trashed folder ID; invalid or trashed IDs silently place files at root."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to initiate and perform a Drive resumable upload session."
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_STOP_WATCH_CHANNEL
Tool to stop watching resources through a specified channel. Use this when you want to stop receiving notifications for a previously established watch. Both `id` and `resourceId` must be saved from the original watch response — they cannot be retrieved after the fact.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "StopWatchChannelRequest",
  "required": [
    "id",
    "resourceId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the channel to stop.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Channel ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the notification channel you want to stop. You can find it in the response returned when you first started the watch."
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Kind",
      "default": "api#channel",
      "examples": [
        "api#channel"
      ],
      "description": "Identifies this as a notification channel used to watch for changes to a resource.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Identifies this as a notification channel. You can usually leave this as the default value."
    },
    "token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Token",
      "examples": [
        "clientToken#0123456789"
      ],
      "description": "An arbitrary string delivered to the target address with each notification delivered over this channel.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Client Token",
      "human_parameter_description": "A secret token you attached to notifications so you could verify they came from Google. Include it if you used one when creating the watch."
    },
    "params": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Params",
      "examples": [
        {
          "ttl": "24"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Additional parameters controlling delivery channel behavior.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "human_parameter_name": "Additional Parameters",
      "human_parameter_description": "Extra key-value settings used for the channel (for example, ttl). Include them only if you set them when creating the watch."
    },
    "address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Address",
      "examples": [
        "https://example.com/notifications"
      ],
      "description": "The address where notifications are delivered for this channel.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Notification Address",
      "human_parameter_description": "The URL that received notifications for this channel. Provide it if you want to ensure we stop the exact channel tied to this address."
    },
    "payload": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Payload",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "A Boolean value to indicate whether payload is wanted.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Payload?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Whether notifications included the full resource details (payload) or just a ping. Provide this only if you used it when starting the watch."
    },
    "expiration": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expiration",
      "examples": [
        "1426325213000"
      ],
      "description": "Date and time of notification channel expiration, expressed as a Unix timestamp, in milliseconds.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Expiration Timestamp",
      "human_parameter_description": "When the channel was set to expire, in milliseconds since January 1, 1970. Optional\u2014include only if you know it and want an exact match."
    },
    "resourceId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Resource Id",
      "examples": [
        "0BwDAzcyS3R3CUlRMW0xVExQNk0"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the resource being watched.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Resource ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The identifier of the file or resource that was being watched. Use the same resource ID you used when you set up the watch."
    },
    "channelType": {
      "enum": [
        "web_hook",
        "webhook"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Type",
      "examples": [
        "web_hook"
      ],
      "description": "The type of delivery mechanism used for this channel.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Channel Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "How notifications were delivered for this channel. For webhooks, use 'web_hook' or 'webhook'."
    },
    "resourceUri": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Resource Uri",
      "examples": [
        "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/0BwDAzcyS3R3CUlRMW0xVExQNk0"
      ],
      "description": "A version-specific identifier for the watched resource.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Resource URI",
      "human_parameter_description": "The full URL of the resource that was being watched. Helpful if you have multiple channels for the same resource."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_TRASH_FILE
Tool to move a file or folder to trash (soft delete). Use when you need to delete a file but want to allow recovery via UNTRASH_FILE. This action is distinct from permanent deletion and provides a safer cleanup workflow.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "TrashFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "id,name,trashed,trashedTime"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Use to limit the amount of data returned. If omitted, returns basic file metadata.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Response fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Specify which file properties to return in the response. Leave blank to get the default set of fields."
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ0123456789"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file to trash.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the file you want to move to trash. You can copy this from the file's URL or from a previous file list/search."
    },
    "supportsAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "default": true,
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to true.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Supports all drives?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on if the file might be in a shared drive. It lets the action find files across both My Drive and shared drives."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UNHIDE_DRIVE
Tool to unhide a shared drive. Use when you need to restore a shared drive to the default view.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UnhideDriveRequest",
  "required": [
    "driveId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "driveId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "0AEMV2k3MjA19Uk9PVA"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the shared drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Drive ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the shared drive you want to unhide. You can find it in the drive's URL or from a previous list of drives."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UNTRASH_FILE
Tool to restore a file from the trash. Use when you need to recover a deleted file. This action updates the file's metadata to set the 'trashed' property to false. Only works while the file remains in trash — recovery is impossible after trash is emptied via GOOGLEDRIVE_EMPTY_TRASH or auto-purged by policy.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UntrashFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ0123456789"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file to untrash.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the file you want to restore from the trash. You can copy this from the file\u2019s URL or from a previous file list/search."
    },
    "supportsAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Supports all drives?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on if the file might be in a shared drive. It lets the action find files across both My Drive and shared drives."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPDATE_COMMENT
Tool to update an existing comment on a Google Drive file. Use when you need to change the content of a comment. NOTE: The 'resolved' field is read-only in the Google Drive API. To resolve or reopen a comment, use CREATE_REPLY with action='resolve' or action='reopen'.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCommentRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "comment_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "id,content,resolved"
      ],
      "description": "Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. The API documentation states this is required. If not specified by the user, this action defaults to '*' to retrieve all fields, ensuring the API requirement is met. Example: 'id,content,resolved'.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Fields Selector",
      "human_parameter_description": "Which details you want returned after the update. If you're unsure, leave it blank and all available fields will be returned."
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content",
      "examples": [
        "This is the updated comment content."
      ],
      "description": "The plain text content of the comment. This field is used to update the comment's text. If not provided, the existing content will be retained unless 'resolved' is being updated.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Comment Content",
      "human_parameter_description": "The new text you want the comment to display. Leave this blank if you only want to change the resolved status."
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the Google Drive file that contains the comment you want to update. You can copy this from the file's URL."
    },
    "resolved": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Resolved",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "NOTE: The 'resolved' field is READ-ONLY in the Google Drive API. To resolve or reopen a comment, use the CREATE_REPLY action with action='resolve' or action='reopen'. This parameter is kept for backwards compatibility but will be silently ignored by the API.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Mark as Resolved? (Read-Only)",
      "human_parameter_description": "NOTE: This field cannot be set directly. To resolve a comment, use the CREATE_REPLY action with action='resolve'. This parameter is ignored by the Google Drive API."
    },
    "comment_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment Id",
      "examples": [
        "11a22b33c44d55e66f77g88h99i00j"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the comment to update.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Comment ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The identifier of the specific comment you want to update on that file. You can obtain it from a previous list of comments or from the comment you created earlier."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPDATE_DRIVE
Tool to update the metadata for a shared drive. Use when you need to modify properties like the name, theme, background image, or restrictions of a shared drive.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateDriveRequest",
  "required": [
    "driveId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "description": "The new name for the shared drive.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the new name you want this shared drive to show in Google Drive."
    },
    "hidden": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Hidden",
      "description": "Whether the shared drive is hidden from the default view.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Is hidden?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Hide this drive from your default view to reduce clutter. Members can still access it via link or search."
    },
    "driveId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "description": "The ID of the shared drive to update.",
      "human_parameter_description": "The shared drive you want to update. Paste the Drive ID from the drive\u2019s URL so we know which drive to change."
    },
    "themeId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Theme Id",
      "description": "The ID of a theme to apply to the shared drive. Cannot be set if colorRgb or backgroundImageFile are set.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Theme ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Pick a visual theme for the drive\u2019s header and color. Leave this blank if you\u2019re setting a custom color or background image instead."
    },
    "colorRgb": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Color Rgb",
      "pattern": "^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$",
      "description": "The color of this shared drive as an RGB hex string (e.g., \"#FF0000\"). Cannot be set if themeId is set.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Color RGB",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose a highlight color for the drive to help it stand out. Provide a hex color like #FF0000."
    },
    "restrictions": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DriveRestrictions",
      "properties": {
        "domainUsersOnly": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Domain Users Only",
          "description": "If true, restricts access to users of the domain to which the shared drive belongs."
        },
        "driveMembersOnly": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Drive Members Only",
          "description": "If true, restricts access to items inside the shared drive to its members."
        },
        "adminManagedRestrictions": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Admin Managed Restrictions",
          "description": "If true, requires administrative privileges to modify restrictions."
        },
        "copyRequiresWriterPermission": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Copy Requires Writer Permission",
          "description": "If true, disables copy, print, or download options for readers and commenters."
        },
        "sharingFoldersRequiresOrganizerPermission": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Sharing Folders Requires Organizer Permission",
          "description": "If true, only users with the organizer role can share folders. If false, users with either the organizer or file organizer role can share folders."
        }
      },
      "description": "A set of restrictions to apply to the shared drive.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose sharing and access limits for this drive, like whether people can copy, download, or share files. Use this to tighten security or relax it for collaboration."
    },
    "backgroundImageFile": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "BackgroundImageFile",
      "required": [
        "id",
        "xCoordinate",
        "yCoordinate",
        "width"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The ID of an image file in Google Drive to use for the background image."
        },
        "width": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Width",
          "maximum": 1,
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The width of the cropped image (0.0 to 1.0). The height is computed (aspect ratio 80:9)."
        },
        "xCoordinate": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "X Coordinate",
          "maximum": 1,
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The X coordinate of the upper left corner of the cropping area in the background image (0.0 to 1.0)."
        },
        "yCoordinate": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Y Coordinate",
          "maximum": 1,
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The Y coordinate of the upper left corner of the cropping area in the background image (0.0 to 1.0)."
        }
      },
      "description": "An image file and cropping parameters for the shared drive's background. Cannot be set if themeId is set.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "human_parameter_name": "Background image file",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select an image from Drive and how to crop it to appear as the drive\u2019s background. Use this if you prefer a custom image instead of a theme."
    },
    "useDomainAdminAccess": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Domain Admin Access",
      "description": "If set to true, the request is issued as a domain administrator.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Send as domain administrator?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on if you need to make changes using domain-wide admin privileges. Use it when updating a drive you manage as an admin rather than as an individual user."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPDATE_FILE_METADATA_PATCH
Tool to update file metadata using the Drive API v2 PATCH method. Use when you need to modify file properties like title, description, or labels using patch semantics.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateFileMetadataPatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "fileId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ocr": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Ocr",
      "description": "Whether to attempt OCR on .jpg, .png, .gif, or .pdf uploads."
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "description": "The title of the file. Used to change the name of the file."
    },
    "fileId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1FT9IW4UpvEc4Ezxv8xS2jEda17MztBXzK7CMqfz-s98"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file to update."
    },
    "labels": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Labels",
      "description": "A group of labels for the file. For example: {'starred': true, 'trashed': false, 'restricted': false, 'viewed': true}.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "pinned": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pinned",
      "description": "Whether to pin the new revision. A file can have a maximum of 200 pinned revisions."
    },
    "mimeType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mime Type",
      "description": "The MIME type of the file."
    },
    "addParents": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Add Parents",
      "description": "Comma-separated list of parent IDs to add."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Properties",
      "description": "The list of properties."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "A short description of the file."
    },
    "newRevision": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "New Revision",
      "description": "Whether a blob upload should create a new revision. If not set, a new revision is created."
    },
    "ocrLanguage": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ocr Language",
      "description": "If ocr is true, hints at the language to use. Valid values are BCP 47 codes."
    },
    "modifiedDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Modified Date",
      "description": "Last time this file was modified by anyone (RFC 3339 date-time). Requires setModifiedDate=true."
    },
    "includeLabels": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Include Labels",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the labelInfo part of the response."
    },
    "indexableText": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Indexable Text",
      "description": "Indexable text attributes for the file (can be used to improve fulltext queries).",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "removeParents": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Remove Parents",
      "description": "Comma-separated list of parent IDs to remove."
    },
    "setModifiedDate": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Set Modified Date",
      "description": "Whether to set the modified date using the value supplied in the request body."
    },
    "writersCanShare": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Writers Can Share",
      "description": "Whether writers can share the document with other users."
    },
    "updateViewedDate": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Update Viewed Date",
      "description": "Whether to update the view date after successfully updating the file."
    },
    "supportsAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to true."
    },
    "timedTextLanguage": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Timed Text Language",
      "description": "The language of the timed text."
    },
    "timedTextTrackName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Timed Text Track Name",
      "description": "The timed text track name."
    },
    "includePermissionsForView": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Include Permissions For View",
      "description": "Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response. Only 'published' is supported."
    },
    "useContentAsIndexableText": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Content As Indexable Text",
      "description": "Whether to use the content as indexable text."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPDATE_FILE_PROPERTY
Tool to update a property on a file using Google Drive API v2. Use when you need to modify an existing custom property attached to a file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdatePropertyRequest",
  "required": [
    "fileId",
    "propertyKey"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "alt": {
      "enum": [
        "json",
        "media",
        "proto"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AltFormat",
      "description": "Data format for response."
    },
    "key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Key",
      "description": "API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token."
    },
    "xgafv": {
      "enum": [
        "1",
        "2"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "XgafvFormat",
      "description": "V1 error format values."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response."
    },
    "fileId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1FT9IW4UpvEc4Ezxv8xS2jEda17MztBXzK7CMqfz-s98"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file."
    },
    "callback": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Callback",
      "description": "JSONP callback function name."
    },
    "quotaUser": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Quota User",
      "description": "Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters."
    },
    "uploadType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Upload Type",
      "description": "Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. 'media', 'multipart')."
    },
    "visibility": {
      "enum": [
        "PRIVATE",
        "PUBLIC"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "PropertyVisibility",
      "description": "Visibility options for the property."
    },
    "oauth_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Oauth Token",
      "description": "OAuth 2.0 token for the current user."
    },
    "prettyPrint": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pretty Print",
      "description": "Returns response with indentations and line breaks."
    },
    "propertyKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Property Key",
      "examples": [
        "test_property"
      ],
      "description": "The key of the property."
    },
    "access_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Access Token",
      "description": "OAuth access token."
    },
    "property_value": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Property Value",
      "examples": [
        "updated_test_value"
      ],
      "description": "The value of this property."
    },
    "upload_protocol": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Upload Protocol",
      "description": "Upload protocol for media (e.g. 'raw', 'multipart')."
    },
    "property_visibility": {
      "enum": [
        "PRIVATE",
        "PUBLIC"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "PropertyVisibility",
      "description": "Visibility options for the property."
    }
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPDATE_FILE_PUT
Updates file metadata. Uses PATCH semantics (partial update) as per Google Drive API v3 — only explicitly provided fields are updated, so omit fields you do not intend to overwrite. Use this tool to modify attributes of an existing file like its name, description, or parent folders. To move a file, supply add_parents and remove_parents together; omitting remove_parents creates multiple parents, omitting add_parents can orphan the file. Bulk updates may trigger 429 Too Many Requests; apply exponential backoff. Note: supports metadata updates only; file content updates are not yet implemented.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPDATE_FILE_REVISION_METADATA
Updates ONLY the metadata properties of a specific file revision (keepForever, published, publishAuto, publishedOutsideDomain). IMPORTANT: This action does NOT update file content. To update file content, use EDIT_FILE or UPDATE_FILE_PUT instead. This action requires BOTH file_id AND revision_id parameters. Use LIST_REVISIONS to get available revision IDs for a file. Valid parameters: file_id (required), revision_id (required), keep_forever, published, publish_auto, published_outside_domain. Invalid parameters (use other actions): file_contents, mime_type, content, name - these are NOT supported by this action.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateFileRevisionMetadataRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "revision_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ0123456789"
      ],
      "description": "Required. The ID of the file whose revision metadata you want to update. Use LIST_FILES or FIND_FILE to get the file ID.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The file whose revision you want to update. Paste the Google Drive file ID (from the file's link) for the item you want to change."
    },
    "published": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Published",
      "description": "Whether this revision is published. This is only applicable to Docs Editors files.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Is this revision published?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to publish this version so others can view it via a public link. Applies to Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides."
    },
    "publishAuto": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Publish Auto",
      "description": "Whether subsequent revisions will be automatically republished. This is only applicable to Docs Editors files.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Republish subsequent revisions automatically?",
      "human_parameter_description": "If enabled, future revisions will be automatically re-published after you make changes. Applies to Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides."
    },
    "revision_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Revision Id",
      "examples": [
        "1"
      ],
      "description": "Required. The ID of the revision to update. Use LIST_REVISIONS to get available revision IDs for a file.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Revision ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific version of the file you want to modify. Use the revision number for the version you intend to keep or publish."
    },
    "keep_forever": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Keep Forever",
      "description": "Whether to keep this revision forever, even if it is no longer the head revision. If not set, the revision will be automatically purged 30 days after newer content is uploaded. This can be set on a maximum of 200 revisions for a file. This field is only applicable to files with binary content in Drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Keep this revision forever?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on to permanently keep this version so it isn't auto-deleted after newer versions are added. Helpful for preserving important snapshots."
    },
    "publishedOutsideDomain": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Published Outside Domain",
      "description": "Whether this revision is published outside the domain. This is only applicable to Docs Editors files.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Is this revision published outside the domain?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether this published version should be accessible to people outside your organization. Leave off to restrict published access to your domain only."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPDATE_PERMISSION
Tool to update a permission with patch semantics. Use when you need to modify an existing permission for a file or shared drive. Inherited or domain-managed permissions may not be editable; verify editability with GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_PERMISSIONS before updating.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdatePermissionRequest",
  "required": [
    "fileId",
    "permissionId",
    "permission"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fileId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file or shared drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the file or shared drive whose permission you want to update. You can find it in the file's URL."
    },
    "permission": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Permission",
      "properties": {
        "role": {
          "enum": [
            "owner",
            "organizer",
            "fileOrganizer",
            "writer",
            "commenter",
            "reader"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "PermissionRole",
          "examples": [
            "reader",
            "writer",
            "commenter"
          ],
          "description": "Permission roles that can be granted in Google Drive."
        },
        "expirationTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Expiration Time",
          "format": "date-time",
          "description": "The time at which this permission will expire (RFC 3339 date-time)."
        }
      },
      "description": "The permission resource to update. Only 'role' and 'expirationTime' can be updated. Role changes take effect immediately and can be difficult to reverse; confirm intent before applying.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "human_parameter_description": "Specify what you want to change: set a new role (like reader, commenter, or writer) and/or choose an expiration time for the permission."
    },
    "permissionId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Permission Id",
      "examples": [
        "01234567890123456789",
        "anyone"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the permission. For anyone-type permissions, use 'anyone' as the permission ID.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Permission ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the specific permission you want to change. You can get this from the file's sharing settings or a previous permissions list. For anyone-type permissions, use 'anyone' as the permission ID."
    },
    "removeExpiration": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Remove Expiration",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to remove the expiration date.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Remove expiration date?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enable this to remove any expiration date on the permission so access no longer expires."
    },
    "supportsAllDrives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Must be set to true when operating on shared drives; omitting this causes the request to fail.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Supports all drives?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enable this if the file could be in a shared drive or My Drive, so the update works in either location."
    },
    "transferOwnership": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Transfer Ownership",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to transfer ownership to the specified user and downgrade the current owner to a writer. This parameter is required as an acknowledgement of the side effect when set to true.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Transfer ownership?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enable this to make the specified user the new owner and downgrade the current owner to writer. Use only if you intend to hand over control of the file."
    },
    "useDomainAdminAccess": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Domain Admin Access",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Issue the request as a domain administrator; if set to true, then the requester will be granted access if the file ID parameter refers to a shared drive and the requester is an administrator of the domain to which the shared drive belongs.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Use domain admin access?",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on if you're a domain admin and need to perform the update on a shared drive in your organization."
    },
    "enforceExpansiveAccess": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Enforce Expansive Access",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether the request should enforce expansive access rules. This field is deprecated, it is recommended to use `permissionDetails` instead.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Enforce expansive access?",
      "human_parameter_description": "If enabled, uses broader access rules when applying the update. Generally leave this off unless you know you need it."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPDATE_REPLY
Tool to update a reply to a comment on a Google Drive file. Use when you need to modify the content of an existing reply.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateReplyRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "comment_id",
    "reply_id",
    "content"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "examples": [
        "id,content",
        "*"
      ],
      "description": "Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. If not provided, defaults to '*' to return all fields.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which parts of the updated reply you want returned (for example: 'id,content'). Selecting only what you need keeps the response simpler and faster. If not specified, all fields will be returned."
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content",
      "examples": [
        "This is an updated reply."
      ],
      "description": "The new plain text content of the reply.",
      "human_parameter_name": "New reply content",
      "human_parameter_description": "The new text you want the reply to say. Enter the updated message you\u2019d like to replace the current reply with."
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1ZdR3L3Kek7szY1j11SQZ9A_00up1j3aA"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The Google Drive file that contains the comment thread. This tells us which file\u2019s reply you want to update."
    },
    "reply_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply Id",
      "examples": [
        "ANmBhkFXXXXX"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the reply.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Reply ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The exact reply you want to change. You can get this by listing the replies for the comment."
    },
    "comment_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAAAAAMAAAAA"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the comment.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Comment ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific comment on the file that the reply belongs to. Use the ID from the comment thread you intend to update."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPDATE_TEAM_DRIVE
Tool to update a Team Drive's metadata. Deprecated: Use the drives.update endpoint instead. Use when you need to modify Team Drive properties.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTeamDriveRequest",
  "required": [
    "teamDriveId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Bug Reproduce Test Drive"
      ],
      "description": "The name of this Team Drive."
    },
    "themeId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Theme Id",
      "description": "The ID of the theme from which the background image and color will be set. This is a write-only field; it can only be set on requests that don't set colorRgb or backgroundImageFile."
    },
    "colorRgb": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Color Rgb",
      "description": "The color of this Team Drive as an RGB hex string. It can only be set on a drive.teamdrives.update request that does not set themeId."
    },
    "teamDriveId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "0AMndV9-YuXjwUk9PVA"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the Team Drive to update."
    },
    "restrictions": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TeamDriveRestrictions",
      "properties": {
        "domainUsersOnly": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Domain Users Only",
          "description": "Whether access to this Team Drive and items inside this Team Drive is restricted to users of the domain."
        },
        "teamMembersOnly": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Team Members Only",
          "description": "Whether access to items inside this Team Drive is restricted to members of this Team Drive."
        },
        "adminManagedRestrictions": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Admin Managed Restrictions",
          "description": "Whether administrative privileges on this Team Drive are required to modify restrictions."
        },
        "copyRequiresWriterPermission": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Copy Requires Writer Permission",
          "description": "Whether the options to copy, print, or download files inside this Team Drive should be disabled for readers and commenters."
        },
        "sharingFoldersRequiresOrganizerPermission": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Sharing Folders Requires Organizer Permission",
          "description": "If true, only users with the organizer role can share folders. If false, users with either the organizer role or the file organizer role can share folders."
        }
      },
      "description": "A set of restrictions that apply to this Team Drive or items inside this Team Drive.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "backgroundImageFile": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "BackgroundImageFile",
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The ID of an image file in Drive to use for the background image."
        },
        "width": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Width",
          "maximum": 1,
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The width of the cropped image in the closed range of 0 to 1."
        },
        "xCoordinate": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "X Coordinate",
          "maximum": 1,
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The X coordinate of the upper left corner of the cropping area in the background image (0 to 1)."
        },
        "yCoordinate": {
          "type": "number",
          "title": "Y Coordinate",
          "maximum": 1,
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The Y coordinate of the upper left corner of the cropping area in the background image (0 to 1)."
        }
      },
      "description": "An image file and cropping parameters from which a background image for this Team Drive is set. This is a write only field; it can only be set on drive.teamdrives.update requests that don't set themeId.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "useDomainAdminAccess": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Use Domain Admin Access",
      "description": "Issue the request as a domain administrator; if set to true, then the requester will be granted access if they are an administrator of the domain to which the Team Drive belongs."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_FILE
Uploads a file (max 5MB) to Google Drive, placing it in the specified folder or root if no valid folder ID is provided. Always creates a new file (never updates existing); use GOOGLEDRIVE_EDIT_FILE to update with a stable file_id. Uploaded files are private by default; configure sharing via GOOGLEDRIVE_ADD_FILE_SHARING_PREFERENCE.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UploadFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_to_upload"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_to_upload": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "File to upload to Google Drive (max 5MB). Must be a dict with fields: `name` (sanitized filename, no slashes or control characters), `mimetype` (accurate MIME type, e.g. `application/pdf`; incorrect values cause Drive to convert or misrender the file), and `s3key` (path from a previously staged Composio object \u2014 not an s3url, not a local path, not a fabricated key). When chaining with TEXT_TO_PDF_CONVERT_TEXT_TO_PDF, pass the returned `s3key` field, not `s3url`.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "human_parameter_name": "File to upload",
      "human_parameter_description": "The file to upload to Google Drive."
    },
    "folder_to_upload_to": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder To Upload To",
      "examples": [
        "1duXYCvYC5tIp5B_B1HWLq8LyDYXfMhPU"
      ],
      "description": "Optional ID of the target Google Drive folder; can be obtained using 'Find Folder' or similar actions. Invalid or missing IDs silently fall back to Drive root with no error \u2014 resolve the correct folder ID first using GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Target folder ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you want the file placed in a specific Drive folder, paste that folder's ID here. Leave it blank to upload to your My Drive (root) instead."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "title": "UploadFileResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",

  "properties": {
    "data": {

            "type": "object",

                "title": "Email Address",

        },

          "description": "Whether the file has been shared."
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_FROM_URL
Tool to fetch a file from a provided URL server-side and upload it into Google Drive. Use when you need to reliably persist externally hosted files into Drive without client-side downloads or temporary storage.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UploadFromUrlRequest",
  "required": [
    "source_url",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "report.pdf",
        "presentation.pptx",
        "data.csv"
      ],
      "description": "Name for the file in Google Drive, including extension (e.g., 'report.pdf', 'image.png')."
    },
    "mime_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mime Type",
      "examples": [
        "application/pdf",
        "image/png",
        "text/csv",
        "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
        "application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet",
        "application/vnd.google-apps.document"
      ],
      "description": "Target MIME type for the file in Google Drive. If not specified, Drive auto-detects from content. Google Workspace MIME types (application/vnd.google-apps.*) trigger automatic conversion from compatible source formats:\n- application/vnd.google-apps.document (Google Docs): converts from Microsoft Word (.docx: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), OpenDocument Text (.odt: application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text), HTML (text/html, application/xhtml+xml), RTF (application/rtf, text/rtf), plain text (text/plain), PDFs (application/pdf), and images (image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/bmp) using OCR (Optical Character Recognition) to extract text\n- application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet (Google Sheets): converts from Microsoft Excel (.xlsx: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), OpenDocument Spreadsheet (.ods: application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet), CSV (text/csv), TSV (text/tab-separated-values), plain text (text/plain)\n- application/vnd.google-apps.presentation (Google Slides): converts from Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation), OpenDocument Presentation (.odp: application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.presentation)\nConversion requires the source content to be in a compatible format. Incompatible formats (e.g., JSON, video files) will cause upload errors."
    },
    "source_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Source Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://example.com/document.pdf",
        "https://cdn.example.com/image.png"
      ],
      "description": "URL of the file to download and upload to Google Drive. Must be a publicly accessible URL or include necessary authentication in source_headers."
    },
    "verify_ssl": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Verify Ssl",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether to verify SSL certificates when downloading from HTTPS URLs. Set to false to bypass SSL verification for URLs with certificate issues (expired certificates, hostname mismatches, self-signed certificates). Only disable for trusted sources."
    },
    "source_headers": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Source Headers",
      "examples": [
        {
          "Authorization": "Bearer token123"
        },
        {
          "X-Custom-Header": "value"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Optional HTTP headers to include when downloading from source_url. Use for authentication tokens, signed URLs, or CDN-specific headers.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "parent_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the parent folder in Google Drive. If not specified, the file will be uploaded to the root of My Drive."
    },
    "supports_all_drives": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports All Drives",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether the request supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to true for broader compatibility."
    }
  }
}
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_UPDATE_FILE
Tool to update file content in Google Drive by uploading new binary content. Use when you need to replace the contents of an existing file with new file data.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UploadUpdateFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "fileId",
    "file_to_upload"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fileId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "1iau-j_ezb2Vcx1tZDMDdfpqlzxVzlscg"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the file to update with new content."
    },
    "addParents": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Add Parents",
      "examples": [
        "1A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9I0J"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of parent folder IDs to add."
    },
    "uploadType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Upload Type",
      "default": "media",
      "examples": [
        "media",
        "multipart",
        "resumable"
      ],
      "description": "The type of upload request. 'media' for simple upload (content only), 'multipart' for metadata + content, 'resumable' for large files."
    },
    "ocrLanguage": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ocr Language",
      "examples": [
        "en",
        "es",
        "fr"
      ],
      "description": "Language hint for OCR processing (ISO 639-1 code, e.g., 'en')."
    },
    "removeParents": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Remove Parents",
      "examples": [
        "1A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9I0J"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of parent folder IDs to remove."
    },
    "file_to_upload": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",

    }
```

## GOOGLEDRIVE_WATCH_CHANGES
Tool to subscribe to changes for a user or shared drive in Google Drive. Use when you need to monitor a Google Drive for modifications and receive notifications at a specified webhook URL. Notifications may be batched rather than per-change; design handlers to be idempotent and fetch all changes since the last known page_token on each notification.

## GOOGLEDRIVE_WATCH_FILE
Tool to subscribe to push notifications for changes to a specific file. Use when you need to monitor a file for modifications and receive real-time notifications at a webhook URL.
